documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our manufacturing team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's manufacturing team is exploring options, but they have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. This lack of clarity is creating operational friction, as they are unable to proceed with arranging a discovery meeting without further clarification.

claims.quote: We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. It sounds like your manufacturing team is exploring options, but you haven't yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To ensure we can provide the most relevant support, could you clarify what specific needs or goals you're looking to address? This will help us prepare for a discovery meeting that aligns with your priorities.
questions: What specific goals or challenges are you looking to address with a potential solution?
Who within your team would be responsible for overseeing this project?
Are there any specific systems or vendors you're currently using that would need integration?
uncertainties: The lack of defined requirements or project owner makes it difficult to assess fit or intent accurately.
